description: This file defines the GuarantorTestBuilder class, which provides methods to construct JSON payloads for testing guarantor-related features in the Fineract project. It includes methods for building guarantor data for existing customers, external guarantors, and includes internal configuration options.

classes.name: GuarantorTestBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating JSON strings representing guarantor information for testing purposes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a JSON string with guarantor data based on current internal state.

methods.name: existingCustomerWithGuaranteeAmount
methods.description: Configures the builder for an existing customer guaranteeing an amount, setting relevant fields.

methods.name: existingCustomerWithoutGuaranteeAmount
methods.description: Configures the builder for an existing customer without specifying a guarantee amount.

methods.name: externalCustomer
methods.description: Configures the builder for an external guarantor type.
